form1[0].Page5[0].PartC[0].builder[0].Ty: Part C. Housing and application type. Type 1A. When you buy the house and land from the same builder or you buy a mobile home. Do not tick Type 1A if you bought a mobile home and you lease land that is not a site in a residential trailer park from the vendor of the home. Tick Type 1B in this case. Fill out Section 1 of Part F to calculate the rebate.

Part C. Housing and application type. Type 1B. When you buy a house and lease the land from the same builder. Do not tick Type 1B if you bought a mobile home from a vendor that also leases to you a site in a residential trailer park. Tick Type 1A in this case. The lease must give you an option to buy the land or must be for a term of at least 20 years. Fill out Section 2 of Part F to calculate the rebate.
form1[0].Page5[0].PartC[0].directly[0].T: Part C. Housing and application type. Type 2. When you buy both the house and land from the same builder or you buy a mobile home. Fill out Section 1 of Part F to calculate the rebate. Attach a copy of your Statement of Adjustments and your signed purchase and sale agreement excluding attachments.

Part C. Housing and application type. Type 3. When you buy a share of the capital stock of a co-op. Fill out Section 3 of Part F to calculate the rebate. Attach a copy of your Statement of Adjustments and your signed purchase and sale agreement excluding attachments.

Part C. Housing and application type. Type 5. When you buy a house and lease the land from the same builder. Do not tick Type 5 if you bought a mobile home from a vendor that also leases to you a site in a residential trailer park. Tick Type 2 in this case. form1[0].Page1[0].Section1[0].Line1Amoun: Section 1. Line 1. If you paid GST on the purchase of the house, enter the amount of GST paid on line 1. If you paid HST on the purchase of the house, enter the result of whichever calculation below applies on line 1.
Section 1. Line 2. Enter the purchase price of the house, do not include the GST/HST.
Section 1. Line 3. Enter the result of your calculation on line 3.

Section 1. Line 4. If line 2 is $350,000 or less, enter the amount from line 3 on line 4. If line 2 is $450,000 or more, enter 0 on line 4, since you are not eligible to claim a GST/HST New Housing rebate. However, if you paid HST, you may still be able to claim a provincial new housing rebate. If line 2 is more than $350,000 but less than $450,000, enter the result of the following calculation on line 4:$450,000 minus line 2, divided by $100,000 multiplied by line 3.

Section 4. Line 13. Enter on line 13 the purchase price of the house, do not include the GST/HST.
Section 4. Line 14. If line 13 is $1,000,000 or less, enter the amount from line 12 on line 14 (maximum $50,000). If line 13 is $1,500,000 or more, enter "0" on line 14, since you are not entitled to a rebate. However, if you paid HST, you may still be able to claim a provincial new housing rebate. If line 13 is more than $1,000,000 but less than $1,500,000, enter the result of the following calculation on line 14:$1,500,000 minus line 13, divided by $500,000 and multiplied by $50,000.
